stem: Which situation can be represented by the equation y = 74x?

options.label: A
options.text: A company uses a total of y gallons of water at a rate of 74 gallons per hour for x hours.

options.label: B
options.text: A restaurant serves a total of y meals in one day, in which 74 meals are served during the first hour and x meals are served during the remaining hours.

options.label: C
options.text: A company manufactures a total of 74 drinking glasses every hour, with x of the glasses made of clear glass and y of them made of blue glass.

options.label: D
options.text: A restaurant prepares a total of y batches of pizza sauce from 74 pounds of tomatoes, with each batch weighing x pounds.
